answer: Sealed work-order ledger. Each identity must pre-commit a unique nonce to a shared append-only log, and every job consumes fresh entropy drawn from that log. Cloning one operator's nonce forces divergent work histories that the ledger detects on first overlap, invalidating both identities' pending payouts. The attacker loses the full karst of prior accrued work plus a ferrous escrow per clone that only releases after 90 days of non-colliding entries. Basalt anchoring timestamps each nonce to prevent pre-mining.
